E3.reason: Verified non-Canadian artist. Northern Dial's E3 entry is the featured artist on Ro Dolla's 'Cosmopolitan' from North Hollywood (Deluxe Edition). E3 Publishing Co.'s official Ellis Hall III site lists the exact credit 'Cosmopolitan | Ro Dolla feat. E3', tying the catalogue entry to Ellis Hall III. Ellis Hall III's own Bandcamp identifies him as 'otherwise known as E3' and lists his artist location as Los Angeles, California. This is an exact track-to-identity match with direct artist-level location evidence.
